supersededBy.reason: Contaminated runs: mutants after the first change of file ran with the previous file's last mutant still applied. See the successor's supersedes.defect. Nothing below was edited.

note: Covers all instruction text routed through promptForStage (prompts.ts) and stageSchema (provider-draft.ts), and the discovery envelope and parsers (discovery-provider.ts). Earlier sweeps on this branch ran over dossier-prompts.ts, which no longer exists; they were dropped with it.
method: Each mutant replaces exactly one occurrence of `old` with `new` in its `file` (applied only when `old` occurs exactly once), runs `npx vitest run` over the four test files, and restores every subject. Killed means the run exited non-zero with at least one failed test.
